exploit_path.preconditions: landlord registered + plotMetadata initialized; >=1 renter staked to landlord
exploit_path.transaction_sequence: L sets currentTaxRate=R0; renter stakes token t0 -> toiler.latestTaxRate=R0; time passes to t; L calls updateTaxRate(R1) (NO forceFarmPlots); renter farms at t1 -> _farmPlots taxes whole [t0,t1] at stale R0 then sets latestTaxRate=R1. Interval [t,t1] never taxed at R1.
exploit_path.state_after: plotMetadata[L].currentTaxRate=R1 but pending interval taxed at R0
exploit_path.rejection_case: Maybe rate is intended to apply prospectively only. But there is no settlement at change time (updateTaxRate lacks forceFarmPlots) AND _farmPlots applies _toiler.latestTaxRate (captured at last farm/stake, L288) to the ENTIRE un-farmed interval, refreshing it only AFTER (L292-293). So neither the old-rate-until-t nor new-rate-from-t semantics hold. Not falsified by any in-scope guard.
exploit_path.source_evidence: updateTaxRate L92-101 (no forceFarmPlots); _farmPlots L287-293 (latestTaxRate used then refreshed)
